text: LEGAL INFORMATION — GAMEBUDDIES.IO Impressum Legal Notice according to § 5 DDG (German Digital Services Act) Service Provider Gamebuddies - Sebastian Krol c/o Online-Impressum #6596 Europaring 90 53757 Sankt Augustin Contact Email: contact@gamebuddies.io Regulatory and Supervisory Authority Landesanstalt für Medien Nordrhein-Westfalen Based in: Germany VAT ID A VAT identification number has not yet been assigned pursuant to § 27a of the German VAT Act (UStG). Consumer Dispute Resolution We are not obliged or willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board. This impressum applies to all legal notice obligations pursuant to § 5 DDG, § 55 (2) RStV & MStV § 18, as well as all social media presences. Privacy Policy & Cookies Information about the processing of personal data — Last updated: 2026-11-04 1. Data Controller Responsible for data processing on this website: Gamebuddies - Sebastian Krol c/o Online-Impressum #6596 Europaring 90 53757 Sankt Augustin Email: contact@gamebuddies.io 2. Data We Collect Account Data When you create an account (via email, Discord, or Google), we store your email address, username, and avatar selection. Authentication is handled by Supabase. Game Session Data We temporarily store game room participation, scores, and game state data to enable real-time multiplayer gameplay. Technical Data When you visit our website or use its online features, technical connection data such as your IP address, browser and device information is processed to deliver content, establish connections and protect the service. Our hosting provider Hetzner Online GmbH also processes connection data. Embedded analytics and advertising services can receive technical data directly from your browser; their purposes and your choices are described in sections 5 to 7. An IP address is personal data and is not anonymous merely because we do not store it in an account. Local Storage We use browser storage for language, audio and theme preferences, session tokens and privacy choices. Consent for optional analytics and consent for advertising are separate choices. The uses of cookies and similar storage are described in section 6. Moderation of Typed Text Player names, chat messages and text typed in games (for example answers, prompts or custom bingo squares) are automatically checked against a list of offensive words. This filter is a fixed word list, not an AI system. If it blocks a text, we store the blocked text together with the game, room code, player name, user ID and time, so that we can check the filter for mistakes and act against repeated abuse. Text that passes the filter is not stored for this purpose. We delete these entries after 12 months at the latest. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in keeping the games free of abusive content). Lobby usage totals To improve the lobby, we count 2D/3D opens and switches, loading outcomes, Premium entry points and wardrobe actions, including when optional analytics is declined. Messages contain only the action and a fixed category and travel over the existing game connection. Successful outfit changes are counted after saving. We check room access and limit excessive requests, then immediately combine the counts by calendar day. These statistics store no names, account, room or session identifiers, IP addresses, individual event times, item identifiers or personal activity histories. They do not set analytics cookies or create browser-storage identifiers. Daily totals are retained for up to 120 days. Connection data needed before aggregation is processed on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, for our legitimate interest in understanding feature usage and improving the lobby with minimal data. The ordinary connection and hosting processing described elsewhere in this policy still applies. Separate detailed UI analytics linked to a user identifier requires analytics consent. To object or ask about this processing, contact contact@gamebuddies.io. 3. How We Use Your Data We use your data exclusively to: Enable multiplayer gameplay and room management Manage your account and save your preferences Track achievements and game progress Improve the platform and fix bugs We also use advertising to finance the service. The processing of advertising data, including the possible disclosure of full IP addresses to advertising buyers, and your choices are explained in sections 6 and 7. 4. Legal Bases for Data Processing We process your data on the following legal bases under the GDPR: Art. 6(1)(b) — Contract fulfillment: Processing necessary to provide our services, including gameplay, account management, and room functionality. Art. 6(1)(f) — Legitimate interest: Processing for security purposes, fraud prevention, and infrastructure operation (e.g., hosting via Hetzner Online GmbH). Art. 6(1)(a) — Consent: Processing based on your explicit consent for optional features such as video chat (WebRTC), optional analytics, and advertising. 5. International Data Transfers Some of our third-party service providers are based in the United States: Supabase (database and authentication) Stripe (payment processing) Google LLC (Google Analytics 4 — cookies only with your consent; cookieless measurement also before or without consent; Google AdSense advertising — personalised only with your consent) Our website and our European game servers run at Hetzner Online GmbH in Nuremberg, Germany. In addition, we operate one game server at a Hetzner location in the United States (Ashburn, Virginia) so that players in the Americas get short response times. If you play through that server, the connection and gameplay data required for it are processed in the United States. PostHog is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt, Germany) and does not transfer data outside the EU. It is used only with your consent for analytics and session recording. These transfers are safeguarded by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and/or Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as approved by the European Commission. You may request a copy of the applicable safeguards by contacting us at contact@gamebuddies.io. Advertising buyers may also receive data outside the EEA. A transfer must have a basis under Chapter V GDPR: for example, an applicable adequacy decision, including the EU-US Data Privacy Framework only for recipients covered by an active certification, or appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses with any necessary supplementary measures. Consent to personalised advertising does not by itself replace these transfer requirements. The partner list in the privacy settings links to the recipients and their transfer information. 6. Cookies & Local Storage Google Analytics 4 also loads before you make a choice and when you decline analytics cookies (Advanced Consent Mode). In these cases, Google receives cookieless measurement pings with consent status, technical request information and a cleaned page address. No Analytics cookies are read or written while analytics storage is denied. Cookieless does not mean that no data is sent to Google. These signals can support aggregate reporting and modelling; they do not provide a complete count of individual visitors. Analytics cookies, our custom game events and PostHog require analytics consent. GameBuddies.io uses optional analytics cookies only with your explicit consent. When you accept analytics cookies, we use: PostHog — for usage analytics, session recordings, and heatmaps to improve the user experience (data processed in the EU) Google Analytics 4 — for traffic analysis and marketing attribution Optional analytics cookies require analytics consent. Advertising has separate consent settings; accepting analytics alone does not enable personalised advertising. You can refuse both optional uses in the privacy settings. We may show advertising through Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use advertising cookies to serve ads based on visits to this or other websites, subject to your consent where required. The following subsection explains advertising data, full IP address sharing, recipients and your choices. Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy · How Google uses data from partner sites: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites · Google Ads Settings: https://www.google.com/settings/ads. Premium members see no ads. We also use local storage (not cookies) for: Authentication session tokens Language preference Audio/music volume settings Theme preference (dark/light) Guest player name Cookie consent preference You can change your cookie preference at any time by clearing your browser storage or clicking the cookie settings link in the footer. You can clear all local data at any time through your browser settings. Advertising, advertising partners and full IP addresses We use Google AdSense to finance the service through advertising. When advertising services are loaded, Google can receive your IP address and technical request information, such as browser and device information. Depending on your privacy choices and the permitted advertising mode, cookies or other identifiers may also be processed to select, deliver and measure ads. With the necessary consent, these data may be used to create advertising profiles and select personalised ads. If full IP address sharing is enabled in AdSense, Google may include your complete, untruncated IP address in bid requests sent to advertising buyers through Authorized Buyers, Display & Video 360 and Google Ads. A bid request offers an advertising placement to potential buyers; recipients can receive the data even if they do not ultimately show an ad. The full IP address can help estimate location and associate requests with a connection or device for advertising selection and measurement. Google restricts this sharing for non-personalised ads, limited ads and restricted data processing requests. For visitors in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, consent for personalised advertising and the associated collection, sharing and use of personal data is obtained through Google Privacy & messaging. The legal basis for processing covered by this consent is Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR; consent-required storage or access on your device is based on section 25(1) TDDDG. Analytics consent alone does not authorise personalised advertising. You can refuse, select individual purposes and providers, or withdraw consent through the privacy settings on this page or in the footer. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing based on consent. Google and the advertising partners shown in the consent dialog may receive and process these data. The partner list links to their privacy information and describes their purposes and retention periods. Recipients may be located outside the EEA; see section 5 for international transfers. Refusing personalised advertising does not prevent you from using the games. Depending on your remaining choices and the applicable requirements, Google may serve non-personalised or limited ads, or no ad. Non-personalised does not automatically mean cookieless, and limited ads do not mean that no technical data is processed. Your consent choices are stored by the consent platform so that they can be respected on later visits. Google states that its website consent cookie FCCDCF has a maximum lifetime of 390 days; you can change your choices sooner at any time. 7. Third-Party Services We use the following third-party services: Supabase — for authentication and database hosting (their privacy policy applies) WebRTC — for peer-to-peer video chat (video/audio data flows directly between players and is not stored on our servers) Stripe — for payment processing of optional premium subscriptions (Stripe's privacy policy applies) Hetzner Online GmbH (Industriestr. 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany) — for website and server hosting. Our servers are located in Germany (EU); one additional game server runs at a Hetzner location in the United States. As our hosting provider, Hetzner may process technical data such as IP addresses at the infrastructure level for security and performance purposes (their privacy policy applies) PostHog — for usage analytics, session recordings, and heatmaps (only with your consent; their privacy policy applies) Google Analytics 4 — for traffic analysis and marketing attribution (cookies only with your consent; cookieless measurement also before or without consent; Google's privacy policy applies) Google AdSense (Google LLC, USA) — for advertising delivery and measurement; Google and its advertising partners use cookies to serve and measure ads, and personalised ads are shown only with your consent, collected via Google's certified consent platform. Opt out: https://www.google.com/settings/ads · https://www.aboutads.info/choices/ · Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy. Premium members see no ads Cloudflare — for passive web analytics and CDN services (no tracking cookies; their privacy policy applies) Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, 7 rue de Madrid, 75008 Paris, France) — for sending announcement emails to larger groups of recipients (e.g. new game launches) and as a fallback for transactional email. Data processed: your email address and delivery metadata (timestamp, delivery status). Processing takes place within the EU. Art. 28 GDPR data processing agreement accepted at registration. No open/click tracking pixels are embedded in our emails. Transactional emails (sign-up confirmations, password resets, magic links, service notices) are sent from our own mail server in Germany; no third party is involved in those messages. 8. Data Retention Account data is stored until you request deletion. Game session data is temporary and deleted shortly after the game ends. For advertising data held by Google and advertising partners, the relevant retention periods or criteria are described in the partner information available through the privacy settings. The lifetime of a consent cookie is not a general retention period for advertising data. 9. Your Rights Under GDPR Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights: Right of access — request a copy of your personal data Right to rectification — correct inaccurate personal data Right to erasure — request deletion of your personal data Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured format Right to object — object to the processing of your data Right to restriction — request limited processing of your data To exercise any of these rights, contact us at contact@gamebuddies.io. We will respond within 30 days. 10. Data Security We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS/WSS), secure authentication via Supabase, and regular security reviews. 11. Children's Privacy GameBuddies.io does not intentionally collect personal data from children under the age of 16. If you believe a child under 16 has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it promptly. 12. Changes to This Policy We publish changes to this privacy policy here with an updated date. Continuing to use the service does not give or extend consent. If a planned processing activity requires consent that your previous choice does not cover, we must obtain it before starting that activity. You can withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future. 13.
